character.movement: one immediate tile per fresh key press, constrained to the playable area

abilities.target: the adjacent tile in Jerv's current facing direction
abilities.timing: immediate on key press; no rhythm clock
abilities.behavior: play the matching four-frame cast VFX and, for Black Hole and White Hole, Jerv's matching cast pose. Full-cast keys leave the matching decorative loop on the target tile after casting. Spells do not alter lighting, map, objects, inventory, or physics.

lighting_probe.aim: mouse position within the playfield; the beam starts at the central STAR and points toward the cursor
lighting_probe.retained_direction: if the mouse overlaps the STAR, keep the last valid direction
lighting_probe.scope: the mode switch changes only the lighting visualization; movement and spell controls remain active
